title: A Counterexample to the Infinite Matroid Packing/Covering Conjecture
summary: We construct in ZFC two self-dual partitional matroids on a countably infinite common ground set that admit neither a packing/covering partition nor an intersection witness. This disproves the unrestricted infinite matroid packing/covering and intersection conjectures and answers Joó's question for two partitional matroids negatively. The examples are neither finitary nor cofinitary.
family_title: Counterexamples to infinite matroid intersection and packing/covering

review.reason: Builds two partitional matroids disproving infinite matroid packing and covering conjectures.
